test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in the bracket to fill in the blank.**

His ______ (repulsive) behaviour could not be ignored.
solution: The correct answer is **"innocuous."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given word is** "repulsive"** which means something that is disgusting or offensive. (घोर नफ़रत पैदा करने वाला; घृणास्‍पद) • **Example**:* I think rats and snakes are **repulsive**__.* • The antonym of **"repulsive"** is **"innocuous." ** • It means harmless or not likely to cause harm. (अहानिकर, सीधा-सादा) __ • **Example**: *I made an **innocuous**__ remark about teachers and she got really angry.* • Therefore, the correct word to fill in the blank is **"innocuous"** as the behavior is not harmful. • The correct answer is Option 2. **Correct sentence**: *His __**innocuous**__ behaviour could not be ignored. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (logical): **seeming natural, reasonable or sensible. (जो स्‍वाभाविक, युक्तिसंगत या तर्कयुक्त प्रतीत हो) • **Option 3 (ambitious): **having a strong desire to be successful, to have power, etc. (महत्वाकांक्षी, उच्‍चाकांक्षी) • **Option 4 (faithful)**: always staying with and supporting a person, organization or belief. ((व्‍यक्ति, संस्‍था, मत आदि के प्रति) सच्‍चा और निष्‍ठावान) 1af:Tc50, The correct answer is **"Refer."**
